Calculate relaxation rates from atomic coordinates

Source: R/ke.R
coord_array_to_relax.Rd

Calculate relaxation rates from atomic coordinates

Usage

coord_array_to_relax(coord_array, rates, spec_den_data_list)

Arguments

coord_array

3D array (atoms, xyz, models) with atomic coordinates

rates

named numeric vector with rates

spec_den_data_list

list of data for calculating spectral density functions

proton_mhz

spectrometer proton field strength in MHz
